definitionOfGood: A thick, softly lit cobalt canyon wall turning through a right-angle corner, made of substantial worn stones with readable broad facets, softened edges and purposeful crevices. Both real ports meet the approved middle as one continuous formation in all rotated native and consumer views, with no lower-face dead area or join shading reset.
independence: Own original/target/style images and actual source collection inspected and initial.json saved before family packet/settings/source; no editor proposal or rationale read.

registration.publication: One whole-frame native4x to published2x BOX reduction, canonical family; no per-view/candidate fitting, pan, warp, recolor, clipping or pixel repairs.

function.identity: W11 cobalt rock-wall corner, blocking world terrain, 1x1 turning obstacle
function.sourceExtremaNotLocks: The source maximum 1.163219 and two-part construction are descriptive. Use the declared 1.17 height budget for useful native redesign while preserving 1.15 joining crown, full ground contact and functional clearance. No new overhang outside authored one-cell corner footprint is proposed.

connectors.otherFaces: Native E and S exterior are not inferred join planes. All four published facings rotate these authored W/N port labels as vectors.
connectors.exactContactLaw: Adjacent roots one unit apart, planes coincident, exact shared profile/crown; no added overlap. Relief must vanish at each real join and transition with compatible tangent, native albedo and smooth normals. No perimeter outline, cap ridge, crown step or world-light reset at a join.

measurementErrorVsCanonical.interpretation: Float storage observation only, not design tolerance or permission for fitting.

shader.detail: Native geometric recesses; no texture images, target card, paint, raster repair or per-view treatment

canonicalContinuity.publication: BOX2x; approved native and published pixels independently reproduced all4. Native PNG bytes differ due metadata; decoded native and published pixel deltas are exactly zero. See reproduction-metrics.json and canonical-native-pixel-reproduction.json.
canonicalContinuity.consumer: Exact current sprite-layout.js orderPlacements including supportedBy; worldRasterPlan anchors common native grid; paintWorldRaster resets imageSmoothingEnabled=false AFTER canvas resize, draws all sprites in order. Final shared canvas is normally browser-filtered via SpriteScene SVG foreignObject at final scene scale.
disallowedAssumptions: Do not apply newer dock filter_size .5 to this family without coordinator reconciliation.
Do not reuse old-corner LANCZOS publication merely because the source reproduces with it.
No extra edge overlap, per-view nudge, warping or manual pixel fixes.
Single front ImageGen target does not establish registration or unseen facings.

aestheticCriteria.good: Several broad, convincingly thick irregular stone masses and softened turning planes replace the original blank slab in all views. The inside bend and outside return look purposefully constructed. Native shape redesign is welcome while exact functional ports and broad ground contact remain correct.

Cyan-blue upper planes, cobalt midtones and deeper blue recesses preserve blue identity and canonical family character. Stone masses and courses remain distinct on lower faces; no near-black unstructured shoulder/base or abrupt banding appears.

Broad soft highlights reveal worn facets without neon cyan outline, icy/glassy ribbons or screen-facing paint. One horizontally symmetric native material/light recipe works through N/E/S/W and translations, with no directional cast ground shadow.

Shallow irregular crevices, worn edges and restrained useful packing detail suggest crafted stone. Avoid flat rectangular plaques, floating chips, noisy microcracks or featureless plastic. Target stones motivate purposeful modeling; exact target pebble count/topology is unnecessary.

At native/published, 192x352 logical frames with 128px cells, and 32px phone/landscape cell pitch, major stone construction and corner turn remain clear. No clipped/chalky edges, halos, z-fighting, exposed internal caps, broken corners, alpha gaps, hard black patches or muddy merged surfaces. Inspect transparent exports over light, gray and dark backgrounds.

Both west and north native profile joins meet the immutable canonical middle at exact roots and in every assembly rotation. Crown profile, material, local normal treatment and light remain continuous with no new seam, perimeter rim, stepped crown or visible exposed connector. Independently published assembly agrees with native geometry assembly under the exact current consumer path and ordinary whole-canvas filtering.

rankedPriorities.outcome: Build substantial readable stone volume and a coherent inside/outside corner instead of the source empty broad slab.
Keep softly lit cobalt form information on every face, especially lower/inside surfaces, and match the canonical middle at both joining lines.
Preserve exact functional registration/profile and demonstrate clean joins through all native and real consumer rotations/scales/phases.

requiredEvidence.source: Hash-bound editable native .blend, exact recipe/settings and closure; root/rotation/camera/frame/pixel-aspect/basis/envelope/ports/static-timing audit. Reopen saved project and reproduce native exports. No target card, paint, warp or pixel repair.
requiredEvidence.static: All four full native 768x1408 RGBA frames, exact whole BOX-published 384x704 frames and 1-frame atlases. Original frame/root registration stays fixed.
requiredEvidence.nativeJoins: Independently assemble candidate corner with exact approved middle native source at W and N, rotate the whole assembly N/E/S/W with actual root matrices. Both join profiles and adjacent visible surfaces must be inspectable. Preserve canonical materials/lighting/capture sampling; any true connected/welded diagnostic is supplemental and must not hide independent cap/alpha seams.
requiredEvidence.consumer: Use current actual consumer or bounded immutable exact-function fixture with snapshotted sprite-layout.js, world-sprite-raster.js and SpriteScene mapping/presentation. Compose independent published corner + canonical middle on common native canvas, nearest sampling after resize, then normal final whole-canvas filter. Include logical128, phone32 and landscape32 cell pitches and representative fractional root/scale/pan phases. No per-view fit, warped placements, added overlap or manual repair.
requiredEvidence.continuityMetrics: Measure actual geometry contact profile/crown, native albedo and seam-normal relation against canonical source; show useful local RGB/alpha cross-sections and explain residuals. Metrics support direct visual inspection; a numerical threshold cannot approve missing/poor imagery.
requiredEvidence.compactVisuals: Retain clearly labeled all4 standalone and joined sheets plus representative consumer images on light/gray/dark backgrounds. Keep reproducible raw evidence without excessive duplicate capture grids.
requiredEvidence.approval: Only the sealed final candidate gets a verdict after all required bytes/views/joins/consumer evidence. Missing evidence yields needs_evidence, not implied pass. Parent freezes these proposals before a fresh editor constructs.

reviewRule: Reward useful authorized native modeling improvements. A source/target shape difference alone is not a defect. Final approval requires clear material improvement, all4 coherent faces and seamless applicable modular/consumer behavior against this frozen contract; at most three material blockers, no numeric automatic approval.
